note: Cases copy the four never-produces tests of listens.rs (fires_when_a_config_override_silenced_the_only_live_producer, silent_once_itemactions_restores_the_event_as_a_live_producer, fires_on_an_external_scoped_declared_but_unproduced_event_with_a_route_on_it, silent_when_an_embedded_child_produces_the_event_up_the_host_chain), each with the FIRED_HEARD answer std-orb-fired-events gives for the same program, plus controls for a child the host does not embed, a transitive embed, an effect producer, a producer on another trait, an undeclared event, a missing trait, an out-of-program orbital, an orbital-sourced route and wildcard or sourceless listens. Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion the Rust validator reports. Each case also carries the CHAINS_HEARD answer std-orb-embed-chain gives for its program and the LINT_COMPUTE step that follows once the fired events and the chains are both in.

findings.message: listens route Browse.EDIT_ROW -> OPEN_EDIT: Browse's emits contract declares EDIT_ROW, but no live effect, rendered affordance, or config item action at this call site produces it — a config override (e.g. itemActions/browseItemActions narrowed) likely removed the only producer
findings.suggestion: restore EDIT_ROW to Browse's active affordance config, or drop the EditModal route if the removal is intentional
